records.text: Owens said a TIME article reported that Israel's influence campaign spent what she believed was 1.5 million dollars per day.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Well, Time did an article today and they're angry. They are angry with Brad Karkar Scal, the government of Israel, because it seems to have backfired. And they are saying that they spent, I believe it was $1.5 million a day.

verification.notes: The official DOJ FARA contract states a budget of 1.5 million dollars per month for four months, not 1.5 million dollars per day. Reporting that summarizes the TIME investigation likewise describes 1.5 million dollars monthly. The speaker appears to have misstated the period.

sources.title: DOJ FARA Exhibit AB for Clock Tower X LLC, registration 7649
sources.relevance: Official services agreement identifying the campaign, intermediary, monthly budget, content targets, Gen Z share, and Salem Media integration.

records.text: TIME reported that Howard Hughes aides controlled which messages reached him, censored his reading, and controlled Hughes and his public image.
records.speaker: TIME

appearances.snippet: To reach him, they censored his reading matters. In short, they controlled Howard Hughes and the public image of him.

verification.notes: TIME's December 1976 profile says the aides decided which messages reached Hughes, censored his reading matter, and in practical terms controlled Hughes. The statement accurately summarizes that report.

sources.title: The Nation: The Keepers of the King
sources.relevance: Direct source for the claims about message control, censored reading, and control over Hughes.
